review_method: Root read complete report and corrected passages, inspected final rendered PNG and adoption API example, and checked historical source hashes. Numerical recounts and detailed report table audit are separate evidence.
scientific_interpretation_checks: Within-configuration disjointness distinguished from cross-configuration overlap.
Eligible pool membership distinguished from actual historical minibatch exposure.
Correctly prescribed CV not invalidated merely by cross-fold overlap.
No claim of historically fresh holdout or independent custody.
All four simulation conditions retained, including negative M1 gap.
Monte Carlo precision distinguished from real model uncertainty.
Simulation does not estimate actual NeuroPixel bias or rescue H1.
Initial failed denominator test and corrected pre-freeze implementation retained.
Opt-in API, caller trust and external chronology limitations explicit.
Resource minima identified as sampled available RAM, not peak RSS or energy.
